lines.4: Theek hai Aarav, zero ka matlab hota hai kuch bhi nahi bacha. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.

lines.8: Tumhare do haath milaakar 8 dikh sakte hain: ek haath 5, doosre se 3. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.9: Haan, ek haath mein 5 aur doosre mein 3—milkar 8. Ab naya card dekho. Tumhare ghar ka number 7 hai. Uske liye kitni taaliyaan bajaoge?
lines.10: Haan, seven taaliyan. Ab 7 batao: pehle seedhi line, phir neeche tirchi line—tum kaise likhoge?
lines.11: Tumne 7 ki seedhi line aur tirchi line batayi—ab usi se 7 likhkar dekho. Riya kehti hai 6 ko ulta kar do to bhi woh chhah hi rahega. Kya woh sahi hai?
lines.12: Tumne kaha ulta karne par nahi; choice screen par tap karo: No, it becomes 9 ya Yes, it is still six. Riya kehti hai 6 ko ulta kar do to bhi woh chhah hi rahega
lines.13: Haan, Aarav. Tumne shape badalne ka reason pakda. Golu poochta hai: tumne kaise jaana—empty plate ya 6 aur 9 same hote hain?
lines.14: Bilkul, zero empty plate jaisa gol hota hai; 6 aur 9 mein gol ke saath tail hoti hai. Screen par 3 dekho—teen dots kitne hain?

lines.0: Namaste Vihaan beta, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket jaisi jumps se 100 banayenge. Tumhe cricket mein batting ya bowling pasand hai?
lines.1: Batting mein chhakke—wah! Ant mein isi jump ko Golu ko sikhaoge. Number line par 94 se 100 tak kitni jumps?
lines.2: Bilkul, 94 se 100 tak 6 jumps. Ab 30 se 100 tak tens mein kitni jumps hongi, Vihaan beta?
lines.3: Tumne 30 se 100 tak saat jumps gini. Ab 46 se 100 tak pehle 40 tak kitni jumps?
lines.4: Koi baat nahi, Vihaan beta. 46 se 50 tak number line par chhoti jumps gino—kitni?
lines.5: Number line par tumne 46 se 50 tak har number gin kar jumps nikale. Khaali jagah bharo: Jump to the next ten: 46 to 50 is ___.
lines.6: Haan, tumne abhi number line par jumps gin kar jawab bataya tha. Ab card par wahi baat likhni hai. Khaali jagah bharo: Jump to the next ten: 46 to 50 is ___.
lines.7: Haan, 46 se 50 tak tumne 4 jumps bilkul sahi ginne. Cricket ki batting yaad hai. Tumhare paas ₹80 hain. ₹100 banane ke liye aur kitne chahiye?
lines.8: Tumne kaha 80 aur kuchh milkar 100 hote hain. Number line par 80 se 100 tak jumps gin kar batao. Tumhare paas ₹80 hain. ₹100 banane ke liye aur kitne chahiye?
lines.9: Tumne 80, 90, 100 gine; ye do jumps hain. Lekin tees bolne par jumps ki ginti dobara milani hogi. Tumhare paas ₹80 hain. ₹100 banane ke liye aur kitne chahiye?
lines.10: Haan, 80 ka partner 20 hai: 80 aur 20 milkar 100. Ab 65 ka partner batao.
lines.11: 35 ya 45 ya 40. 65 ke saath kya milaayein ki 100 ban jaaye?
lines.12: 65 mein 45 jodne par 110 hota hai. 65 ko 70 banane ke liye 5, phir 30 aur jodo—kul kitna?
lines.13: Haan, 5 aur 30 milkar ek hi jump banate hain. 65 + ___ = 100
lines.14: Haan, tumne pैंतीस bola tha. Meri baat ulajh gayi—ab tumhari baat ko dhyan se sunungi. 65 + ___ = 100
